content.title: About
content.content: Light ice cream, NFS is a low‑calorie frozen dessert made from skimmed milk, natural sweeteners, and a small amount of cream. It offers a light, creamy texture and a gentle flavor, ideal for those watching their calorie intake but still craving something sweet.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The ice cream contains about 30 % less fat than traditional versions.
The formula uses stevia‑based sweeteners, making it virtually sugar‑free.
Available in three flavors: vanilla, strawberry, and chocolate.
The product is tested to be gluten‑ and lactose‑free, suitable for most diets.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: A 100 g serving provides roughly 90 kcal, allowing you to enjoy ice cream without a major energy boost.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Skimmed milk supplies a good amount of calcium, essential for bones and teeth.

items.title: Contains vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D aids calcium absorption and supports the immune system.

items.title: Low sugar
items.content: Stevia sweeteners do not cause rapid blood‑glucose spikes.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Probiotics added to the product promote a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Despite the low fat, the product contains milk proteins that may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Sensitivity to sweeteners
items.content: Some individuals may experience mild gastrointestinal discomfort from stevia.

items.title: Artificial flavorings
items.content: Certain flavors may contain additives that are unsuitable for people sensitive to food additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the ice cream at –10 °C to –12 °C. You can top it with fresh berries, nuts, or mint for extra flavor. Avoid leaving it at room temperature for more than 30 minutes to prevent ice crystal formation.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to prevent absorption of other odors. Discard the product if ice crystals form or the color changes.
